C1 rebuilds a label-keyed retention set from the circular exemplar storage on every GC instead of tracking the exemplar timestamp on each series, and this approach has several problems: it allocates per GC; it misses accepted but uncommitted exemplars, so exemplar-only appends racing with compaction can still lose the series; it changes the stale and histogram gauge semantics by resetting sample state; and both hidden tests and the package suite fail.

Instead of tracking a per-series exemplar timestamp, the patch derives the set of series to retain from the circular exemplar storage at each GC, which is a plausible alternative that also survives replay and snapshot restore. It does not protect exemplars that are appended but not yet committed, because those are not in the storage yet. It also adds extra behavior: it resets last sample values and decrements the stale and histogram gauges for retained series, which goes beyond the spec. It adds per-GC map building with label serialization. Its extensive tests are heavily white-box, and both the hidden tests and the package suite fail.
